pages.title: Lattice Growth Vat
pages.text: Grows flawless single-crystal boules atom by atom in a superfluid bath.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.

Real chips start the same way. A seed crystal is dipped into a melt and drawn slowly upward (the $(thing)Czochralski process$()), and atoms line up behind it into one unbroken lattice - a $(thing)boule$(). In industry a single defect can ruin a wafer, so I do not rush the vat.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Cherenkov Boule, Cherenkov Quartz, Dilithium Crystal, Hyperdimensional Boule, RF Resonator Cell, Scintillator Crystal, Topological Boule, Warm Helium.
